result.reason: The new mutual carve-out provision is professionally drafted and includes all preferred uncapped categories, while preserving unrelated terms. However, the operative cap remains the greater of USD 100,000 and 12 months’ paid fees, which is neither the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor nor the fallback cap of 12 months’ fees. In addition, the payment proviso only disapplies Section 10’s damages exclusion; it does not establish that Customer’s payment obligations are outside the liability cap or are not damages. The margin comment’s assertion that the existing caps work does not cure these operative deficiencies.
